name: Nullscapes
tagline: GET OUT OF MY HEAD. Kiba built the whole thing alone.

facts.note: Ranked #9 on the Pointercrate Demonlist as of 30 August 2026, the highest current position of anything on this list. GDBrowser reports 63,308 objects, which is under the API's 16-bit ceiling and so is a real figure. The level's in-game description is “GET OUT OF MY HEAD”.

spotlight.eyebrow: Currently ninth in the world, and built by
spotlight.sub: ItzKiba made, decorated and published it alone. Zoink verified it.

voice.hook: One person, 63,308 objects, and ninth in the world.
voice.why:
Nullscapes is the hardest level on this list by current Demonlist position, sitting at #9. ItzKiba built it alone — no megacollab, no roster, one person and 63,308 objects.

The in-game description is three words long: GET OUT OF MY HEAD. Zoink verified it. It is a 2.2 level and it feels like one, using the update's effects to make empty space genuinely unpleasant to look at.
